items.basis: The filter media is sized on P95 load (3.6 kg/h), but the mechanism's stated target is the dump episodes, which by the load study's own heavy-tailed structure sit ABOVE P95 (14 episodes in ~13,000 operating hours is roughly the P99-and-beyond region, not the P95 region). A media bed sized to capture 3.6 kg/h is, by its own sizing basis, undersized for the episodic loads it exists to catch; the flow-share boost (10%→25%) increases water throughput, not solids capture capacity per the sizing claim. The claimed 5x suppression of episode clogging therefore rests on a filter being adequate in exact
